report:
Na učinjenim MR presjecima kroz lijevo koljeno vide se difuzno zone masne supstitucije, bez
koštanog edema. Vidi se blaga anteriorna translacija tibije.
Vide se sitne fisure hrskavice lateralnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba kao i trohlearne
hrskavice - hondromalacija II. stupnja. Hondromalacija I. stupnja hrskavice medijalnog platoa
tibije kao i patelarne hrskavice.
Prednji križni ligament je nabran, promijenjenih intenziteta signala, bez jasnog prikaza vlakana
na samom havtištu za femur - kompletna ruptura.
Stražnji križni ligament održan, primjerenih intenziteta signala.
Menisci su umjereno degenerativno izmjenjeni.
Kosa ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska s otvaranjem na tibijalnu plohu.
Edem posterolateralne zglobne čahure, bez evidentne meniskokapsularne separacije.
Bez znakova rupture lateralnog meniska.
Anterolateralni ligament je povišenih intenziteta signala u smislu distenzije, moguće i parcijalne
rupture.
Kolateralni ligamenti su bez znakova rupture.
Tetiva m. kvadricepsa i loigament patele primjerenog prikaza.
Burzitis tetive m. semimembranosus.
Manji zglobni izljev, predominantno suprapatelarno.
Ostali nalaz neupadljiv.

MRI of left Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS, AX T2W FS

* The contour of ACL not in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside, in favor of tear.
  Laxity contour of MCL with increased signal intensity on F/S T2WI, in favor of partial tear.
> The contour of PCL and LCL in a straight line and increase signal intensity inside PCL and proximal LCL on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1 injury.
> Some joint effusion and  suprapatellar bursitis with suprapatellar, lateral and medial plica; mild hypertrophy of the synovium, indicative of mild synovitis.
> Abnormal signal intensity is noted in proximal tibia ( more prominent at posterior tibial plateau and intercondylar eminance) and distal femur, which shows low signal intensity on T1WI and high signal intensity on T2WI, in favor of bone contusion.
  Suspicious of mild impaction of lateral femoral condyle. 
   > Linear signal intensity in posterior horn of lateral meniscus, and unclear contour of central portion, in favor of bucket handle tear of lateral meniscus.
> Bone marrow edema over low pole of patella and mild increased signal intensity of patellar tendon on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 1  injury.
  Mild laxity of medial patellar retinuaculum with increased singal intensity on F/S T2WI, in favor of grade 2 injury.
  Howevere, no dislocation of patella in this study.
> Mild muscle edema over vastus lateralis and medialis muscle and subcutaneous edema.
Impression: 
1. C/W ACL tear.	
2. High grade partial tear of MCL.
3. Grade 1-2 injury of PCL and grade 1 injury of proximal LCL.
4. C/W bucket handle tear of posterior horn of lateral meniscus. 
5. Bone contusion of left proximal tibia and distal femur and low pole patella.
6. R/O transient patellar dislocation with impaction of lateral femoral condyle and low pole of patella and suspicious of partial tear of medial patellar retinaculum.
7. Synovitis and patellar plicae of left knee and small Baker's cyst.  
8. Mild muscle edema over vastus lateralis and medialis muscle and subcutaneous edema.  
Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain for one month.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.  

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES: 
Alignment is anatomic.  No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process.  No aggressive osseous lesions.  

JOINT SPACE:
0.8 cm osseous body identified posteriorly, medial to the distal posterior cruciate ligament. 
Moderate joint effusion. Moderate, ruptured Baker's cyst. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus:  Oblique undersurface tear of the posterior horn and body with dominate complete radial tear at the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Mild extrusion of the body. 
Medial compartment cartilage: High-grade chondrosis anterior weightbearing portion of the femoral condyle with subchondral cystic change/edema.  

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: No tear. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild chondrosis.    

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: 
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: High-grade chondrosis of the patella and to less extent trochlea with areas of full-thickness cartilage loss with subchondral cystic change/edema.     

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.  
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Mucoid degeneration of the distal PCL with small intraosseous ganglion at insertion.  

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.  
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.  
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. 

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.  
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad.  No lateral patellar tilt or translation.  No patella alta.  Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 11 mm. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS: 
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.  Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact. 

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. 

IMPRESSION:
1.	Tear of the medial meniscus with dominate radial tear at the posterior root . 
2.	Intra-articular osseous body.
3.	Moderate joint effusion and moderate Baker's cyst.
4.	Tricompartment chondrosis.

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn. There is acute osteochodnral fracture at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.5* 1.3 cm). 
 The patellofemoral joint, there is no patellar translation.  There is acute osteochondral injury at medial patellar facet (about 1.6* 1.5 cm). There is low grade sprain of the medial patellofemoral ligament, near femoral attachment. 
  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments are intact There is no tibial translation. 
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact The popliteofibular ligament is intact The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of left knee effusion is present. No free osteochondral fragment. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Suspicious patellar dislocationrelocation injury of left knee; evidence of  
  Acute osteochondral injury at medial patellar facet (about 1.6* 1.5 cm).  
  Low grade sprain of the medial patellofemoral ligament, near femoral attachment. 
  Acute osteochodnral fracture at mid weightbaring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.5* 1.3 cm). 
  Grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament.

MRI of right Knee with 
-Locator, SG PD FatSat, SG T2W FS, AX T2W FS, SG T1W, CO T2W FS

> Wearting of articular cartilage of patella with fissure and irregular contour of medial aspect of patella and medioinferior protruding contour patella  
  Mild fat stranding over infrapatellar fat pad
> The contour of ACL & PCL appear to be within normal, no abnormal signal intensity is noted.
> No evidence of tear is noted in either medial or lateral meniscus.
> Both medial & lateral collateral ligaments appear to be within normal.
> Minimal joint effusion in right knee. 
Impression: 
1. In favor of old avulsion fracture of right patella and grade 3 patellar chondromalacia and spur formation; differential diagnosis of medial patellar bipartite and degeneration.
2. Mild infrapatellar fat edema.

Suggest correlation with clinical manifestation

FINDINGS:

There is a large knee joint effusion.

There is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament near its femoral insertion. There are pivot shift bone marrow contusion with a subchondral impaction fracture involving the lateral femoral condyle with associated significant bone marrow edema. There are also bone contusion involving the medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau without fracture.

There is high-grade tear of the medial collateral ligament with complete disruption of its fibers at its femoral attachment with also thickening and increased signal throughout the superficial component. There is no distal avulsion or proximal retraction of the distal superficial component. There is also complete tear of the deep meniscal femoral component with significant thickening of the meniscal tibial component.

There is a horizontal tear involving the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending to the inferior articular surface. There is no displaced meniscal fragment. There is a an oblique tear involving the posterior horn of the lateral meniscus at the insertion of the Wrisberg ligament compatible with a Wrisberg rip.

There is edema involving the myotendinous junction of the popliteus. The popliteus tendon itself is intact.

Otherwise the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the semimembranosus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Complete tear of the ACL.

2. High-grade sprain of the medial collateral ligament without evidence of pseudocyst Stener.

3. Medial and lateral meniscal tear without displaced fragment.

4. Pivot shift bone marrow contusion with subchondral impaction fracture of the lateral femoral condyle.

5. Moderate knee joint effusion.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküs posterior horn gövde düzeyinde grade III dejenerasyon ve horizontal yırtık izlendi. Menisküs posterior komşuluğunda parameniskal kistler izlendi. Medial menisküs mediale doğru hafif ekstrude görünümdedir.Lateral menisküs normaldir.Medial kollateral ligamen, periligamentöz alanda hafif ödem görünümü izlendi ( grade I sprain ). Arka çapraz bağı posterior komşuluğunda büyüğü 14 mm çaplı birkaç adet kist izlendi.Ön çapraz bağ, lateral kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar kıkırdak medial fasette kıkırdakta hafif incelme ve bu düzeyde subkondrial milimetrik kist izlendi ( grade II kondromalazi ). Eklemde sıvı artışı saptanmamıştır. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Popliteal fossada yaklaşık 17 mm çaplı lobüle konturlu baker kisti izlendi.

Multifragmentarna fraktura stražnjeg dijela lateralnog platoa tibije sa širenjem frakturne pukotine
u proksimalni tibiofibularni zglob i pomakom ulomaka za 4 mm.
Zone kontuzije kosti femoralnih kondila, manja lateralnog, veća medijalnog promjera 10 mm.
Lamelarni izljev uz distalni dio iliotibijalnog trakta, suspektna sitna avulzijska fraktura pri hvatištu
za tibiju.
Blaga subluksacija tibije dorzalno u femorotibijalnom zglobu.
Opsežan hemoragizirani izljev u zglobu i u Bakerovoj cisti veličine 7 cm.
Hondromalacija kondilarne i tibijalne hrskavice II stupnja, uz nekoliko traumatskih defekata
hrskavice lateralnog platoa tibije.
Potpuna ruptura prednjeg križnog ligamenta.
Potpuna ruptura stražnjeg križnog ligamenta.
Kompleksna ruptura prednjeg roga, trupa i stražnjeg roga lateralnog meniska. Avulzija hvatišta
prednjeg roga.
Degenerativno promijenjen medijalni menisk uz moguću rupturu prednjeg korijena i prednjeg roga.
Parcijalna ruptura lateralnog kolateralnog ligamenta pri hvatištu za femur i distenzija u
preostalom dijelu. Formirani veći rubni osteofiti FT i FP zgloba u sklopu OA promjena.
Distenzija medijalnog kolateralnog ligamenta.
Moguća parcijalna ruptura medijalnog i lateralnog retinakuluma patele, analiza limitirana
artefaktima pomicanja.
Ruptura tetive m. popliteusa.
Gubitak napetosti patelarnog ligamenta što vjerojatno odgovara parcijalnoj rupturi, uz tendinozu
na hvatištu.
Edem u mekim tkivima.
Izljev oko prikazanog dijela n. ischiadicus, n. peroneus i n. tibialis.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Rodilla traumática aguda.
Hallazgos:
Edema óseo periférico asociado a fractura subcortical del platillo tibial medial, con edema las
partes blandas regionales.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
No hay significativo derrame articular ni quistes poplíteos.
Fragmentación de la tuberosidad anterior de la tibia con discreto edema. Leve aumento de señal
del tendón rotuliano regional.
Tendón cuadricipital, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de
límites normales.
Ligamento patelofemoral medial dentro de límites normales.
Importante edema del tejido celular subcutáneo del aspecto anterior y lateral de la rodilla con
laminar cantidad de líquido profundo regional.
Impresión:
Edema óseo periférico asociado pequeña subcortical del platillo tibial medial.
Fragmentación de la tuberosidad anterior de la tibia con discreto edema óseo y leve tendinosis
rotuliana distal que podría representar reactivación de una enfermedad de Osgood Schlatter,
correlacionar con clínica.
Edema del tejido celular subcutáneo del aspecto anterior y lateral de rodilla con laminar cantidad
de líquido profundo regional.
